text.title: JPA / Hibernate Decision Tree
text.summary: Routing tree mapping observable signals — workload shape, entity diff, bulk op, new aggregate, read vs write path, test layer — to a rule from 01-core-rules.xml.

decision-tree.root-question: Workload shape, and which part of the JPA layer is being touched?

conclusion.verdict: skip-this-methodology — use Spring Data JDBC / jOOQ for reporting
skip-this-methodology — use jOOQ / native queries; JPA proxy cost dominates

branch.question: PR modifies an entity (@Column / @JoinColumn / type / rename)?

conclusion.verdict: ship paired Flyway migration in the same PR; expand-contract for rename/type
return DTOs from controllers; map inside transactional service

branch.question: Aggregate is user-editable with concurrent writers?

conclusion.verdict: add @Version; the service catches OptimisticLockException and surfaces a domain error; PESSIMISTIC_WRITE only for inventory / balance writes
add @CreationTimestamp (updatable=false) + @UpdateTimestamp before anything else touches the entity

branch.question: Declaring cascade or orphanRemoval on the association?

conclusion.verdict: write the Javadoc justification for cascade + orphanRemoval + fetch; CascadeType.ALL without one is blocked
leave FetchType.LAZY; load per query via JOIN FETCH or @EntityGraph where a caller needs it

branch.question: List query over potentially many rows?

conclusion.verdict: project to a DTO in the query; add JOIN FETCH only if the DTO needs an association
single-entity load via a narrow repository method; raw JpaRepository never reaches a service signature
@Transactional(readOnly = true) on the service method; never annotate the repository
@Transactional on the service write method; map to DTOs before returning

text.example: shape=transactional_oltp → entity_diff=true → flyway-migration-per-entity-change → ship V12__add_invoice_status.sql with the entity change.
shape=transactional_oltp, touching=read_path → is_list=true → dto-projection-on-reads → add `findAllSummaries(Pageable)` returning `OrderSummaryDto`; no entity hydrated.
